proposals.evidence: CDIAL 13551.2 *sūñcī explicitly gives Bengali sũc/suc and Oriya suñci needle. Bengali śuc and Oriya sũn.ci fit this subsection, retaining sibilant, nasal and syllable-marker notation. The primary article permits denasalized Bengali suc, so that form is not assigned mechanically to the nonnasal subsection. Local Indo-Aryan transmission remains unresolved. Exact response: śuc.
